### Welcome — `/welcome`

- Id: `welcome`
- Purpose: The pack’s hero: the promise in one line, one way in.
- Primary action: Shuru karein → `/login`
- Other taps:
  - Pehle se account hai? Login → `/login`
  - Pehle demo dekho (45 sec) → `/`

- Guide ids: `hero`, `start`, `demo`, `guest`
- Roles: owner: The first screen for anyone not signed in.; staff: Same.; accountant: Same.
- Tour (what the voice says):

  - `start`: “Shuru karne ke liye yahan tap karo.”

### Login — `/login`

- Id: `login`
- Purpose: Phone, then the SMS code. The code fills itself in and moves on; no password anywhere.
- Primary action: Aage → `/setup/[step]`
- Other taps:
  - Peeche → `/welcome`
  - Build ke dauran: /dev/switch se koi bhi bano → `/dev/switch`
- Fixture states: phone, code
- Guide ids: `phone`, `next`, `code`, `resend`, `guest`
- Roles: owner: Everyone signs in the same way.; staff: Same.; accountant: Same.
- Tour (what the voice says):
  - `phone`: “Apna phone number likho. Isi se login hota hai.”
  - `next`: “Aage dabao, SMS se code aayega.”

### Setup — `/setup/[step]`

- Id: `setup`
- Purpose: First time: one question per screen. Name, GST status, then only what that answer needs (GSTIN, turnover, IRN). "Sab sahi hai?" starts the app; UPI, city, signature and PAN are offered there and can wait for Aap.
- Primary action: Chalo, shuru karte hain → `/`
- Other taps:
  - Aage → `/setup/[step]`
  - Abhi nahi → `/setup/[step]`
  - Abhi bhar deta hoon → `/setup/[step]`
  - Badlo → `/setup/[step]`
  - Peeche → `/setup/[step]`
- Fixture states: name, gst, gstin, turnover, irn, review, pan, upi, city, sign
- Guide ids: `hello`, `answer`, `next`, `skip`, `go`, `more`
- Roles: owner: Only an owner sets up a business.; staff: Not reached: staff are invited into a business.; accountant: Same as staff.
- Tour (what the voice says):
  - `hello`: “Namaste ji! Hum pehli baar mil rahe hain, to apne baare mein thoda bataiye.”
  - `answer`: “Yahan jawab likho ya chuno. Ek baar mein ek hi sawaal.”
  - `next`: “Aage dabao. Galti ho to peeche aa sakte ho.”
  - `go`: “Sab sahi hai? Yahan dabao, app shuru ho jaayega.”

### Ghar — `/`

- Id: `home`
- Purpose: A hello by name, the two opening buttons (20 Oct: the star Pakka bill banao, a tax invoice; beside it Kaccha bill banao, an estimate for the customer to check first; "Apne baare mein batao" until the person has said their name), then three questions: Kiska bill? Bheje hue bills. Kiske paise aane hain. The mic is the centre of the tab bar.

### Bill ban gaya — `/bills/new/done`

- Id: `bill-done`
- Purpose: The tick, the bill as the customer will see it (white, English), and the door: the customer's WhatsApp number (theirs on record, or typed now: their chat opens straight away, saved contact or not, with the bill's own link) and WhatsApp pe bhejo; File share karo for the PDF or photo. Another size, home, one more for the same customer. An estimate (kaccha bill) also offers Pakka bill banao.
- Primary action: WhatsApp pe bhejo → `external:whatsapp`
- Other taps:
  - Doosra size → `/bills/new/done`

- Tour (what the voice says):

  - `whatsapp`: “Customer ka number daalo: seedha unki WhatsApp chat khulegi. Send aap dabao.”
  - `share`: “PDF ya photo: jo customer ko aasaan lage.”

### Bill — `/bills/[number]`

- Id: `bill-view`
- Purpose: One sent bill: what is due, large; Paise aa gaye (Poore / Kuch hissa); Yaad dilao; WhatsApp dobara (the number, then their chat); Download; and, folded, "Galti ho gayi?" with cancel-and-redo and the credit note. A kaccha bill (estimate, 20 Oct): its amount, Pakka bill banao (or the pakka bill made from it), WhatsApp dobara, Download, and the estimate's cancel.
- Primary action: Paise aa gaye → `/bills/[number]`
- Other taps:
  - Poore → `/bills/[number]`

  - Cancel karke naya banao → `/bills/new`
  - Rakam kam karo → `/bills/[number]/credit-note`
  - Peeche → `/bills`
- Fixture states: due, partial, paid, cancelled, credit-note
- Guide ids: `amount`, `paid`, `remind`, `wa`, `download`, `paper`, `mistake`, `paid-sheet`, `adjust`, `entries`, `pakka`, `wa-sheet`, `share-file`
- Roles: owner: Everything.; staff: No cancel, no credit note.; accountant: Read, download. No money, no reminder.
- Hidden per role: staff: `mistake`, `adjust`; accountant: `paid`, `remind`, `wa`, `mistake`, `adjust`
- Tour (what the voice says):
  - `amount`: “Itna baaki hai is bill pe.”

  - `remind`: “Yaad dilana ho to ek tap.”

- Tour (what the voice says):
  - `choices`: “Contract ka percent, kisht, ya running bill: jo aapka hai woh chuno.”
  - `paste`: “Contract ka text ho to yahan daalo, hum bhar denge.”
  - `plan`: “Is bill ka poora hisaab yahan.”

### Dev switch — `/dev/switch`

- Id: `switch`
- Purpose: The build’s door while sign-in is off: become any seeded person with their business and role.
- Primary action: none
- Other taps:
  - Sharma ji → `/`
- Fixture states: default
- Guide ids: `people`
- Roles: owner: Lists everyone.; staff: Same.; accountant: Same.
- Tour (what the voice says):
  - `people`: “Build ke dauran: kisi bhi naam pe tap karke wahi ban jao.”

## Golden paths

### (a) Repeat bill to a regular customer, sent on WhatsApp

- Budget: 4 taps; counted: 4
- Starts at: `/`
- Sequence:
  1. Home → chip "Mehta Traders"
  2. Bill → "Haan, wahi bharo"
  3. Bill → "Bill banao · ₹7,316"
  4. Bill done → "WhatsApp pe bhejo"

### (d) Brand-new owner: welcome to the first bill handed to WhatsApp

- Budget: 16 taps; counted: 16
- Starts at: `/welcome` as new
- Sequence:
  1. Welcome → "Shuru karein"

  5. Home → the greeting's "Na" (no tour this time)

  8. Setup → "Aage"
  9. Setup → "Nahi" (GST mein registered? — answers and moves on)
